scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate && npm run build:shared
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @tiyas/shared" "npm run dev -w @tiyas/api" "npm run dev -w @tiyas/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tiyas/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tiyas/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tiyas/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tiyas/api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
